# AMEVA-Forge Full Technical Specification (v1.0.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Browser-Native WebGPU Deep Learning Tensor & Autograd Engine with PyTorch Syntax
Compiles autograd computation graphs directly to WGSL WebGPU compute shaders, executing training and inference entirely on the client GPU with zero server egress.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: ameva
- Command: pip install ameva
# or in browser:
<script src="https://uno-km.github.io/uno-km/lib/forge/ameva.js"></script>
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/AMEVA-Forge

## 3. Core Capabilities
- **Deterministic 0-Drift Output**: Bit-exact floating-point precision verified across heterogeneous ARM64 & WebGPU hardware.
- **Zero Cloud Egress Architecture**: Operates 100% on the local client without external network telemetry leaks.
- **Memory Leakage Protection**: Weakref lifetime management preventing GPU VRAM / system RAM leaks.

## 4. Canonical Implementation
```python
import ameva as am

# PyTorch-compatible WebGPU Engine
x = am.tensor([[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]], device="webgpu", requires_grad=True)
y = (x ** 2).sum()
y.backward()
print("WebGPU Gradients:", x.grad)
```
